description: Adds two case studies carrying no publishedAt so sortByPublishedAtDesc takes the "|| ''" arms on both sides of its comparator (src/components/CaseStudies/index.js line 25) and their rows render the empty arm of the date cell (line 204). Every checked-in study has a publishedAt, so those arms are unreachable from the shipped data. Two records rather than one because a single undated study only ever lands on one side of a comparison against the dated ones; with two, the pair is also compared with each other and both fallbacks run. These are extra records rather than a cleared field, so the studies already on the page keep rendering exactly as they did and the arms are added rather than swapped.

caseStudies.title: Coverage Fixture Org: a case study with no publication date
Coverage Fixture Collective: a second case study with no publication date
